sentences.text: This dinosaur reached an estimated length of 7 meters.
The holotype, which is the specimen the species is based on, consists of a partial skull measuring 32 centimeters in length.
Its head features a distinct dome and round eye sockets.
Other recovered remains include ribs, bony armor plates, and one isolated tooth.
Fossils were collected from the Cloverly Formation in central Montana between 1996 and 1998.
The type species T. cooneyorum was formally described by William L. Parsons and Kristen Parsons in 2009.
Basal traits include retained premaxillary teeth and an uncovered lateral temporal fenestra.
Tatankacephalus is classified within the class Ornithischia.
It belongs to the family Nodosauridae.
Cladistic analysis places it as a basal member of Ankylosauridae closely related to Gastonia.
The animal lived during the Albian stage, from 113.2 to 100.5 million years ago.
Researchers argue the fossil is not deformed, allowing distinction from Sauropelta edwardsorum found in the same formation.
